Info

Implementation of spatial 4-DOF SCARA forward and inverse pose kinematics.

class scaralang.core.service.kinematics.solver.analytical.spatial.pose.solver.SpatialPoseKinematicsSolver(planar: IPlanarKinematicsSolver, vertical: VerticalBounds)[source]¶

Bases: object

Defines class SpatialPoseKinematicsSolver implementing ISpatialPoseKinematicsSolver contract. Analytical SCARA 4-DOF forward and inverse kinematics calculation engine.

It defines:

attributes:
_DEFAULT_ANGLE - Default fallback joint angle in radians.
_planar - Injected planar 2D arm kinematics solver collaborator.
_vertical - Injected vertical limits for linear travel validation.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes spatial pose solver with planar solver and vertical limits.
solve_fk_4d - Computes 4-DOF Cartesian pose from joint coordinates.
solve_ik_4d - Solves 4-DOF inverse kinematics from Cartesian pose.
get_version - Returns solver component version string.
_DEFAULT_ANGLE: ClassVar[float] = 0.0¶
_planar: IPlanarKinematicsSolver¶
_vertical: VerticalBounds¶
get_version() → str[source]¶

Returns solver component version string representation.

Returns:

Semantic version string.

Exceptions:

None.

solve_fk_4d(theta1: float, theta2: float, z: float, theta4: float) → CartesianPose[source]¶

Computes 4-DOF Cartesian pose from joint coordinates via forward kinematics.

Parameters:

  • theta1 – Joint 1 (shoulder) angle in radians.

  • theta2 – Joint 2 (elbow) angle in radians.

  • z – Linear vertical position in mm.

  • theta4 – Joint 4 (wrist) angle in radians.

Returns:

CartesianPose instance in mm and radians.

Exceptions:

None.

solve_ik_4d(pose: CartesianPose, elbow_left: bool = False) → ScaraJoints[source]¶

Solves analytical inverse kinematics for 4-DOF Cartesian pose with vertical limit check.

Parameters:

  • pose – Target CartesianPose instance in mm and radians.

  • elbow_left – True for elbow-left configuration, False for right.

Returns:

ScaraJoints instance containing joint configuration, reachability and status.

Exceptions:

None.
